camera_direction.description: Camera viewing axis and roll relative to the subject, distinct from height, distance and body orientation.
camera_direction.description_ko: 카메라 관측 방향과 대상 대비 각도: 높이·관찰 위치·몸 방향이 섞임; 관측축과 위치를 별도 표현
excludes: 높이·관찰 위치·몸 방향이 섞임; 관측축과 위치를 별도 표현
includes: Camera viewing axis and roll relative to the subject, distinct from height, distance and body orientation.

color.description: Owned local colors and bounded color arrangements, separate from whole-image grading.
color.description_ko: 지정 대상·영역의 색과 색 배치: 전역 색 보정·HDR과 구별; 배경 색을 주체 색으로 바꾸지 않음
excludes: 전역 색 보정·HDR과 구별; 배경 색을 주체 색으로 바꾸지 않음
includes: Owned local colors and bounded color arrangements, separate from whole-image grading.

gaze_target.description: Explicit target of an identified gaze carrier, including a declared human or animal, with actual gaze-bearing scope and target grounded separately from head orientation, eye state and visual engagement.
gaze_target.description_ko: 사람·동물을 포함한 명시된 시선 주체의 실제 관찰 목표. 시선 부위와 목표 소유 범위를 각각 증명하며, 머리 방향·눈 상태·눈맞춤·실제 인지 성공과 구별한다.
excludes: Head/body turn, pupil shape, eye closure, an empty-looking expression or a target location alone does not identify a gaze target.
A human/animal/robot/portrait label alone proves no eyes, gaze-bearing anatomy or performed gaze. Explicitly represented gaze remains on its represented carrier; biological anatomy is not donated.
Directed sensor/camera hardware, a lamp beam or device aiming alone is not biological or represented gaze. Artificial facial response alone is not gaze direction or a target.
Named target does not prove attention, successful seeing, consciousness, desire, camera awareness, engagement or target placement.
Do not add eyes, a face, phone or counterpart, or replace an independently selected secondary/background gaze carrier with a primary default.
includes: An explicitly declared human or animal looking at an identified existing target; source category does not change the same gaze-target meaning.
Looking into a phone camera supplies that named gaze target; it does not identify the camera actually recording the photograph or establish eye contact with the viewer.

Retain the exact gaze carrier, independently available relevant eye/gaze scope and actual target. Source/binding intrinsic restrictions stay conjunctive; select or preserve the gaze relation only as the whole source declares.

material_mechanics.description: Explicitly declared softness, hardness, rigidity, stiffness, flexibility, deformability or elastic response of one identified material, object material region or material layer, distinct from its identity, optical finish, static geometry and actual motion.
material_mechanics.description_ko: 소유자가 특정된 물질·물건의 재료 영역·재료층에 직접 선언된 부드러움·경도·강성·뻣뻣함·유연성·변형성·탄성 반응. 재질 정체·광학 마감·정적 형상·실제 움직임과 구별하며, 외관만으로 물성을 추정하지 않는다.
excludes: Material names, glossy appearance, crinkling, folds, roundness, a spring/hinge label or a soft visual mood alone without an explicit mechanical-quality proposition.
Actual motion, a selected transformation stage, part assembly, static layer thickness or object width/height alone; no duplicate role on the same property merely by renaming its carrier.

Soft anatomical contour, temporal fullness, expression, emotional softness or light softness alone is not constitutive material softness. An independently declared biological or represented carrier is not inferred from the role.

Do not infer chemistry, modulus, force, numeric hardness, safety, durability, load capacity, a pressure source, pneumatic operation or measured success. Preserve any explicitly stated real value or condition rather than deleting it for lack of measurement certification.
No mass, density, lightweight claim, temperature or moisture is established by softness, rigidity or flexibility. No new layer, object, body part or actor follows from this slot.
includes: An explicitly rigid toe-ring object retains that same ring as carrier; its circular outline and worn placement are separate facts.

Explicit soft polymer and flexible pneumatic channels retain their separately declared actual material/channel owners. Deforming edges are actual motion, not proof that every material region is flexible.

A declared mechanical quality is a source requirement, not a certified measurement. A selected quality is an effect; a separately required existing quality is a prerequisite; an express preservation keeps the exact independently frozen quality.

material_thickness.description: Explicit physical thickness or thinness of one identified material layer or its bounded cross-section, separate from in-plane width, whole-object outline, optical opacity and material identity.
material_thickness.description_ko: 소유자가 특정된 재료층 또는 그 경계 단면의 직접 선언된 물리적 두께·얇음. 면 안의 폭·전체 물체 윤곽·광학 불투명도·재질 정체와 구별하고, 층이나 단면을 새로 만들지 않는다.
excludes: Broad/substantial width, long length, large garment volume, a chunky style name or visible edge alone without actual thickness meaning. Ambiguous chunky-band wording must not silently select a cross-sectional axis.
Optical opacity/transmission, pigment concentration, thin cosmetic coverage, a thin light band, anatomical slenderness or low visual density alone.
Material softness, stiffness, mass, lightweight status, strength, insulation or chemistry inferred from thickness.

Physical assembly or whole-object geometry already fully expressed by a specialized construction role does not receive a second thickness fact by renaming that same geometry. Separate positive material-layer thickness can coexist with distinct construction, texture or optical facts.
Do not invent a separate backing layer, new material body, exact dimension, wearer, body part or product from the role name.
includes: An explicitly thin fabric layer in loose trousers retains the material-layer owner; crinkling, garment openings and loose fit have separate meanings.
A declared plastic layer with bounded thick edges supports its material cross-section thickness. Its transparency, reflections, flexibility and the edge outline remain separately evaluated.

Mode follows the complete source: selected thickness is an effect; required existing thickness is a prerequisite; explicitly maintained thickness is preservation. Preserve a stated number/unit literally without inventing one.

narrative_phase.description: Selected instant or phase within an explicitly declared human, natural, mechanical or other event, distinct from clock time, a named occasion and inferred chronology.
narrative_phase.description_ko: 명시된 인간·자연·기계 등 사건 안에서 선택한 순간이나 단계. 하루 시각·행사 명목과 구별하며 사건의 원인·완료·연속 경과를 추론하지 않는다.
excludes: Clock time, season, historical era and the name of an occasion alone.
An inferred preceding cause, unmentioned event, completed outcome or elapsed sequence.
Do not infer rainfall from wetness or a clock time from low tide; a phase requires its explicit source event relation.
includes: Explicit before/after/during relations and selected natural-event phases, including an already declared loading event, rainfall or tide.
Human participation is not required. Existing source conditions and actual event/carrier identity remain mandatory.
A procedure operation or material transformation can additionally have its own role; a selected event phase alone does not supply the operation or transformation.

prop_state.description: Owned object's current use, attachment, readiness, damage or arrangement state, with occupational context optional.
prop_state.description_ko: 물건의 사용·정리·고정·손상 상태: 업무 소품으로만 한정할 근거가 약함; duty는 맥락 조건으로 보존
excludes: 업무 소품으로만 한정할 근거가 약함; duty는 맥락 조건으로 보존
includes: Owned object's current use, attachment, readiness, damage or arrangement state, with occupational context optional.

scale_relation.description: Comparative size relation between explicitly identified entities with a stated depth or perspective basis.
scale_relation.description_ko: 둘 이상의 명시된 대상 간 크기 관계: 절대 크기·원근 왜곡과 구별; 비교 기준과 깊이 관계를 보존
excludes: 절대 크기·원근 왜곡과 구별; 비교 기준과 깊이 관계를 보존
includes: Comparative size relation between explicitly identified entities with a stated depth or perspective basis.
